headline: Nubank alum raises $85 million for an AI investment adviser charging a flat fee
body: Decade, an AI investment adviser from Nubank alum and CEO Vitor Olivier, emerged from stealth with an $85 million seed round, the largest ever raised by a Latin American startup. Decade charges a flat fee of about $40 a month instead of earning commissions, and connects to a customer's full financial life through Brazil's open banking APIs to flag high-fee products and offer on-demand access to a human advisor for bigger decisions.
note: Early usage data shows customers act on its recommendations, with the chance of holding a flagged asset falling from about 20% to 2%, an early test of whether flat-fee AI advice can out-compete Brazil's commission-based advisory business, where an advisor's income still depends on what they sell.

evidence.text: A Nubank alum raised $85 million, the largest seed round in Latin American history, to build Decade, an AI investment adviser that CEO Vitor Olivier says will deliver “self-driving money.”
His new company, Decade , recently emerged from stealth with an $85 million seed round, the largest ever raised by a Latin American startup.
Decade charges a flat fee of about $40 a month instead of earning commissions.
For that fee, customers get a platform that connects to their full financial life through Brazil’s open banking APIs.
It consolidates spending and investments, flags high-fee products or tax inefficiencies and offers on-demand access to a human advisor for bigger decisions.
Early usage data shows customers act on its recommendations, with the chance of holding a flagged asset falling from about 20% to 2%.
Brazil’s investment advisory business still runs largely on commissions, so an advisor’s income depends on what they sell rather than what fits the client.
Vitor Olivier spent years building the infrastructure behind Nubank , the Brazilian digital bank that gave roughly 100 million people a cheaper, simpler way to handle everyday transactions.
